countingMethod.wordLength: Count Unicode precomposed Hangul syllables. Every raw pool word is entirely U+AC00..U+D7A3, so Unicode character, grapheme, syllable and Dart UTF-16 length counts agree.
countingMethod.glossLength: Source Unicode characters including whitespace/punctuation. Also record UTF-16 count. Character counts are not pixel-width measurements; final UI must use real font layout.
countingMethod.runtimeSelection: Exact static reproduction of KkeunmariEngine.load predicate: noun whitelist membership AND word.length>=2 AND first==word[0] AND last==word[last]. No CEFR or word-length family heuristic applied.

inputContract.allowedCharacters: Precomposed Hangul syllables U+AC00..U+D7A3 only after trim.

boundaryExamples.note: Inserted internal space; deliberately invalid input probe, not a new pool word.

inputContract.twentySyllableBoundary: The code permits 20 Hangul syllables, but no 20-syllable entry exists in the current bundled pool or noun index (max5/max8 respectively). Do not label fabricated 20-syllable strings as real vocabulary or valid dictionary answers.

glossContract.selection: KkeunmariWord.meaning normalizes language variants; en selects English, all other UI locales select German.
glossContract.missingEnglish: Empty English remains empty; no fallback to German.
glossContract.customPack: VocabDeckSource.wordChainPool restricts exact selected Korean terms to the curated dictionary; meaningFor returns selected row translation. Custom glosses can exceed this fixed bundled corpus audit.
glossContract.glossWhitespace: Multiword German/English glosses are supported and must wrap; this does not imply spaces are accepted in Korean submitted words.

preservationRequirements: Do not cap visible syllable tiles at five just because curated pool maximum is five; real accepted dictionary-only words reach eight, and engine input shape allows twenty.
Do not assign CEFR from syllable count. Stored level labels are reported unchanged and are not used for fit-family decisions.
Keep all letters and full German/English glosses visible through measured layout and responsive wrapping/scroll when necessary.
Preserve the 20-character input limit, external-whitespace trim, internal-whitespace rejection, exact first-syllable checks and used-word rejection.
Keep empty English hidden and dictionary-only blank glosses; do not invent translations.
Keep dynamic live next-count logic; asset next_count/is_dead_end fields describe the full persisted corpus and are not layout constraints.
